title: fix(auth): the direct sign-in door accepts the state an identity provider echoes after sign-out
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoA1ALjVcUcAuAA15MyUocBx)_

Fixes #35474

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:开启“退出后回到身份提供方登录页”的部署里,若退出时带了状态值,身份提供方送回时原本停在一个报错页,现在直接看到身份提供方的登录页;不带状态值的退出(随附控制台的做法)前后一样。
- 为什么做:补齐“退出后经身份提供方登录页返回”这一能力,替托管环境的退出回程解决一个按标准协议发送状态值就会断掉的问题。
- 出错会怎样:碰到的是自行发送状态值的宿主或客户端,最坏情况是退出后仍停在报错页、保持已退出(不会误登录);改动很小,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/direct-sign-in.ts`: the direct sign-in door's closed query set (`DIRECT_SIGN_IN_QUERY_PARAMS`) is now `callbackURL` and `state`, each accepted at most once. `state` is never read and never forwarded into the new authorize: the door starts a fresh sign-in with the vendor's own state cookie, exactly as without it. The repeated-name check now runs over the whole set, so `?state=a&state=b` answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with the shared repeated-parameter sentence, like a repeated `callbackURL`. Any other name is still refused `400` (AGENTS.md route rule 5 stands: nothing outside the declared set is dropped). The docblock says why `state` is there: under `afterSignOut: 'identity-provider'` the door is the post-logout redirect URI, and the provider echoes the `/sign-out` body's `state` onto it (OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 §3).
- `auth-route-ledger.ts`: the `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct` note gains one clause for the accepted, unread `state`.
- `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`: one sentence in "Sign-out through the identity provider".
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.

Choice pinned (the card's Done-when offered three): accept and ignore. Round-tripping has no target (the door's next hop is a fresh authorize, not the RP that minted the value), and documenting "callers must not send one" would leave `/sign-out`'s own declared `state` body member (`sso-sign-out-of-idp.ts` `SignOutBody`, forwarded by `oidcEndSessionUrl`) breaking the documented return that published contract text promises (`auth-endpoints.zod.ts` afterSignOut: "identity-provider sends it back through GET /auth/sign-in/direct, so the identity provider shows its own sign-in page").

Read first, by risk:
1. `direct-sign-in.ts` `runDirectSignIn`, the refusal block (the `repeated` computation): the arity rule now spans both names, and the unknown-name sentence still outranks it.
2. `direct-sign-in.ts` `DIRECT_SIGN_IN_QUERY_PARAMS` docblock: the reason `state` is a declared, value-ignored member.
3. `direct-sign-in.test.ts`, the last top-level `describe` (the card's pins).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/direct-sign-in.test.ts` should print `Tests  121 passed (121)`.

## Why

Measured on origin/main b65488a8: the door answered `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for `?callbackURL=/x&state=abc` and for the bare post-logout return `?state=abc`. `state` reaches the door because the Console (and any client) sets the sign-out `callbackURL`, the post-logout redirect URI, to `{basePath}/sign-in/direct` under `afterSignOut: 'identity-provider'` (`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` `signOutReturn`), `/sign-out` forwards a body `state` to the provider's end-session endpoint, and the provider appends it on the redirect back. That includes the platform acting as provider: `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12 `getRegisteredLogoutRedirect` does `redirectURI.searchParams.set("state", state)`. The shipped Console sends no `state`, so the UI did not reach this; a host or client that does, as OIDC allows, did.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared-harness file `direct-sign-in.test.ts` (AGENTS.md: a pin for a component with a shared harness goes into that file):
- `?callbackURL=%2Fx&state=rp-opaque-abc` answers the same `302` location as without `state`; the vendor start received a byte-equal body, and the echoed value appears nowhere in it.
- Mounted (real `AuthPlugin` routes over a real `AuthManager`, `afterSignOut: 'identity-provider'`): `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct?state=rp-opaque-abc` answers `302` to the identity provider's authorize with the vendor's own state, not the echoed one.
- `?callbackURL=%2Fx&state=a&state=b` answers `400` with `error` equal to `{ code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: repeatedQueryParamMessage('state', 2) }`, and nothing is started.
- CONTROL: `?state=a&next=%2F` is still refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, starting nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- The IP allow-list landing (`directSignInNetworkRefusal`) reads only `callbackURL` and needed no change: a blocked client with an echoed `state` still lands on `/login?error=IP_NOT_ALLOWED`.
- `Clause-②: no` is the claim's reading: the refusal of an echoed `state` was a mis-refusal that the published afterSignOut text already negates; no new route and no new export name. The door's accepted query set does grow by one name, which the claim records as the bug fix and not a widening.
- `packages/spec/**` untouched.
